name: 武动仙途
english_name: Wu Dong Xian Tu (Martial Path to Immortality)
english_description: A large, 46,890-file archive built for a dedicated GUI client rather than plain telnet: on connecting, the server issues a version challenge the client must answer with a correctly encrypted response (or one of two built-in bypass strings) or be disconnected as an "illegal client," and registration/character-creation fields arrive as single lines separated by a full-width vertical bar (║) rather than one prompt at a time — neither is a bug. Alongside a standard Jin Yong sect map (Huashan, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, Ming Cult), it layers on a full modern MMORPG-style instanced-dungeon system (副本/"fuben" zones, including named boss instances) that is unusually elaborate for this generation of mudlib, plus a real payment-callback service (payd.lpc) — evidence this install was once wired up to an actual web-recharge storefront rather than being a purely free text MUD. Shares its connection protocol and mixin architecture with this collection's NT/nitan/Lonely-lineage libs (xfbhh, hhsj, nt1, nitan170911), with its own additional F_SUIT mixin.
